{{Quote|These techno-idiots cower like frightened coneys before us.|General Naem Yrros|<ref name="Rhamalai">{{JournalCite|13|The Occupation of Rhamalai}}</ref>}}
'''Coneys''' were creatures that could be easily frightened. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Naem Yrros]] likened the [[Rhamalian]]s to frightened coneys due to their insistence on not relying on any forms of modern technology.<ref name="Rhamalai" />
